items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (effective 2027-01-01)
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The price change takes effect on 01.01.2027. The letter grants an extraordinary right to terminate the contract without notice if the customer rejects the new price, provided the cancellation reaches the provider 'vor diesem Tag' (before 01.01.2027). The last day the cancellation may still arrive is therefore 31.12.2026. Checking the weekday: 01.01.2026 was a Thursday, and 2026 has 365 days (not a leap year), so 31.12.2026 (day 365) falls on the same weekday as 01.01.2026, i.e. Thursday — a normal business day, so no §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension is needed.
